name: ourgroceries
description: Manage shared OurGroceries shopping lists, recipes, items, and categories through ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: OurGroceries lets you view shared shopping lists and recipes, see list items and categories, create new lists, and update items and categories for your OurGroceries team. An OurGroceries account is required.
defaultPrompt: What items are left on my grocery list?
Add milk, eggs, and bread to my grocery list.

positive.expected_behavior: Returns the test account's shopping lists with IDs, names, and list types.

positive.description: Inspect active items in a selected list.
positive.prompt: Show the items still to buy on my Weekend Groceries list.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Weekend Groceries list and returns its active items, including notes and categories when available.

positive.description: Create a recipe list with a new name.
positive.prompt: Create a recipe list called Pasta Night.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the recipe list and returns its ID, name, and type.

positive.description: Add several items to an existing list in one request.
positive.prompt: Add milk, eggs, and bread to my Main Grocery list.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Main Grocery list and reports the result of adding each item.

positive.description: Create or rename categories after checking existing names.
positive.prompt: Show my categories, then add Snacks and rename Produce to Fresh Produce.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the existing categories and reports the outcome for each requested category change.

negative.description: Do not trigger for an unrelated calendar request.
negative.prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?

negative.description: Do not trigger for public restaurant recommendations.
negative.prompt: Find the best Italian restaurants near me.

negative.description: Do not trigger for a request to alter account access.
negative.prompt: Change the email address and password on my account.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release of the OurGroceries ChatGPT plugin.
